title: Valuation of AI Code Testing Startup Blacksmith Rises Nearly 10 Times in One Year

content_html:
Today, with the rapid rise of artificial intelligence, writing code has become faster than ever. But new issues have also emerged: how reliable is the massive amount of code generated by large models? Testing and verification have become a new challenge for development teams. That's why the startup Blacksmith, which focuses on code testing and verification, has experienced explosive growth.

Recently, the company announced a new Series B funding round of $4.5 million, led by PeakXV Partners, with existing investors GV and YCombinator participating. Notably, its valuation has surged nearly tenfold in less than a year, rising from $60 million after its $10 million Series A round to $550 million, with a total funding amount reaching $5.85 million.

Founded in 2024, Blacksmith aims to help enterprises complete building, testing, and verification before software goes live. With the popularity of AI programming tools like Cursor, Codex, and ClaudeCode, code generation has become effortless, but quality control has become a new bottleneck. The company's founder and CEO, Aditya Jayaprakash, pointed out that the more code people write, the more the pressure for verification increases exponentially.

Initially, Blacksmith entered the market as a cloud service provider for continuous integration workloads. Today, its business has expanded to include an AI programming assistant called Codesmith, which automatically fixes failed code checks. Currently, the platform's customer base has grown from over 700 a year ago to more than 5,000, including well-known companies such as Mercury, Supabase, Clerk, Ashby, and Expensify.

In terms of team size, the company has achieved a "tens of millions of dollars" annualized revenue run rate with only about 30 employees, and some major customers spend more than $1 million per year. However, facing intense competition, Blacksmith is also facing pressure from GitHub Actions, built-in verification features of major AI tools, and the combined forces of traditional cloud giants Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. The team said that in the future, they will continue to expand the code tool ecosystem and help developers write, verify, and merge software at a faster speed.

content_html_zh:
如今，随着人工智能的迅速崛起，编写代码变得比以往任何时候都快。 但新的问题也随之出现：大型模型生成的海量代码的可靠性如何？ 测试和验证成为开发团队面临的新挑战。 这就是为什么专注于代码测试和验证的初创公司 Blacksmith 经历了爆炸性增长。

近日，该公司宣布完成新一轮 450 万美元 B 轮融资，由 PeakXV Partners 领投，现有投资者 GV 和 YCombinator 跟投。 值得注意的是，其估值在不到一年的时间里飙升了近十倍，从1000万美元A轮融资后的6000万美元升至5.5亿美元，总融资额达到585万美元。

Blacksmith成立于2024年，旨在帮助企业在软件上线前完成构建、测试和验证。 随着Cursor、Codex、ClaudeCode等AI编程工具的流行，代码生成变得不再困难，但质量控制成为新的瓶颈。 该公司创始人兼首席执行官 Aditya Jayaprakash 指出，人们编写的代码越多，验证的压力就会呈指数级增加。

最初，Blacksmith 作为持续集成工作负载的云服务提供商进入市场。 如今，其业务已扩展到包括名为 Codesmith 的人工智能编程助手，它可以自动修复失败的代码检查。 目前，该平台的客户群已从一年前的700多家发展到5000多家，其中包括Mercury、Supabase、Clerk、Ashby、Expensify等知名公司。

从团队规模来看，该公司仅用约30名员工就实现了“数千万美元”的年化营收运行率，部分大客户每年的支出超过100万美元。 然而，面对激烈的竞争，Blacksmith 也面临着来自 GitHub Actions、各大 AI 工具内置验证功能以及传统云巨头 Amazon Web Services、Microsoft Azure 和 Google Cloud 合力的压力。 该团队表示，未来他们将继续拓展代码工具生态系统，帮助开发者以更快的速度编写、验证和合并软件。
